description: Encrypted blobs (SPEC §11). padded = u32be(len(P)) || P || zero bytes, where the padded length is the §3.1 bucket rule applied to 4 + len(P) (multiples of 256 up to 4096, then multiples of 4096, no 65536 cap). P is at most 1044476 bytes so that ct stays within 1048576. aad = lp("carom/v1/blob") || lp(mime); ct = ChaCha20-Poly1305(key, nonce = 12 zero bytes, aad, padded); id = b64(SHA-256(ct)); hash = b64(SHA-256(P)[0..16]). Convergent keys (app and small icons): key = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = group key, salt = SHA-256(P), info = "carom/v1/blob-conv", L = 32). seal cases are byte-exact and ref is the exact reference JSON. open_cases are checked in order: reference shape (bad_ref), b64(SHA-256(ct)) == id (bad_id), decryption (decrypt_failed), exact padding (bad_padding), plaintext length == size (bad_size), hash (bad_hash). expected is "ok" or the first failing code; plain_hex is the plaintext for "ok" and null otherwise.

unpad_invalid.name: padded length is not the bucket size for the prefix

convergent_key.name: the same app icon under kv 2 gives another key

seal.name: random key, photo past the 4096-byte bucket (jpeg, 1080x720)
convergent key under kv 1, app icon (webp, 128x128)
convergent key under kv 1, small icon (webp, 96x96)
random key, empty plaintext, no dimensions

open_cases.name: last ciphertext byte flipped, id unchanged
last ciphertext byte flipped, id recomputed
non-zero padding under a valid tag
length prefix past the data under a valid tag
size is one more than the plaintext
